    local -a full_args=(cargo install --path "$direct_path" --bin "$direct_binary")
    if [[ $force_install -eq 1 ]]; then
        full_args+=(--force)
    fi

    printf '==> %s\n' "$tool"

        return 0

    failed_tools+=("$tool")
    printf 'error: install failed for %s\n' "$tool" >&2
    return 1

# All non-direct tools are installed via a single install-ctl invocation so
# artifacts sharing a source path (e.g. ticket + ticket-mcp, spec-cli +
# spec-mcp) are built once instead of once per sibling with a different
# --bin/--features combination, which used to thrash the shared target dir
# and force full rebuilds of common dependencies on every install.
install_ctl_batch() {
    local -a tools=("$@")
    local -a subcommand_args=(install "${tools[@]}")
    local -a full_args=("${install_ctl_cmd[@]}")

    if [[ $force_install -eq 0 ]]; then
        subcommand_args+=(--no-force)
    fi
    if [[ $dry_run -eq 1 ]]; then
        full_args+=(--dry-run)
    fi
    full_args+=("${subcommand_args[@]}")

    printf '==> %s\n' "$(IFS=', '; echo "${tools[*]}")"

    if ! (cd "$repo_root" && "${full_args[@]}"); then
        failed_tools+=("${tools[@]}")
        printf 'error: install failed for: %s\n' "${tools[*]}" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    installed_tools+=("${tools[@]}")
    return 0
}

    case "$tool" in
        install-ctl|peek-cli|test-cli|fs-cli|compact-terminal-cli|context-cli)
            direct_tools+=("$tool")
            ;;
        *)
            ctl_tools+=("$tool")
            ;;
    esac
done

for tool in "${direct_tools[@]}"; do
    install_one_direct "$tool" || true
done

if [[ ${#ctl_tools[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then

Repointed consumers: memory-api's audit-api, memory-matrix (cli.rs + matrix.rs dispatch), session-api, session-cli, session-mcp (path -> git rule dep), and workflow-tools/spec's rule-api bridge (memory-api bridge -> real rule git dep). Deleted legacy memory-api/crates/rule-api, tools/cli/rule-cli, tools/mcp/rule-mcp. Root Cargo.toml: added rule/rule-api workspace members + [patch."https://github.com/mankinskin/rule"] entry; removed rule-api from the memory-api patch block; added a new [patch."https://github.com/mankinskin/memory-fixtures"] entry (published remote is behind the in-tree copy, missing empty_workspace/EmptyWorkspace).

Validation: cargo build -p rule -p rule-api (slim + all-features) green; cargo test -p rule -p rule-api all-features: 49+68 lib tests + smoke_test + toon_output integration tests all pass. cargo build --workspace green. cargo test -p memory-matrix -p audit-api -p session-api: audit-api (7) and session-api (0/no tests) pass; memory-matrix 15/17 pass with the same 2 pre-existing unrelated failures previously diagnosed for ticket/audit (cargo run -p ticket-mcp --quiet fails: no package named ticket-mcp, it's a bin inside the ticket package) — out of scope, unrelated to rule.

Deliberate exclusion: dropped tests/install_contract_sync.rs (validated memory-api's own README/.spec doc sync for the retired tools/cli/rule-cli install path) — it doesn't test rule's behavior and its assertions (cargo install --path tools/cli/rule-cli) are now stale by design; not ported.

Committed bottom-up: workflow-tools/rule (802b3d3, 0a3ed44), workflow-tools/spec (41bdbda), workflow-tools (9256d1c, 9853420), memory-api (1798a559), context-engine root (84a752bf + follow-up).
